name: musubi-claude
description: First-class Claude Code adapter for Musubi memory: SessionStart continuity, Stop capture, a read-only recall MCP facade (recent/search/get/status) plus durable remember, and recall/continuity skills. Shadow-only by default — no remote write until delivery_mode is explicitly set to verified. Built on the shared musubi-harness runtime so the Claude and Codex seats share one contract.

actor.title: Musubi actor
actor.description: Your Musubi identity, e.g. alice. Lowercase letters, digits, '.', '_' or '-'. Leave empty to keep using an existing config.json.

seat.title: Seat
seat.description: This machine or agent seat, e.g. laptop. Your presence becomes actor/seat.

zone.title: Zone
zone.description: Which zone this seat belongs to.

delivery_mode.title: Delivery mode
delivery_mode.description: shadow keeps captures local (nothing leaves this machine); verified sends them to Musubi and reads each one back.
